entities.summary: Henk Nijboer is a Dutch civil servant, researcher and politician of the Labour Party (PvdA) who served as a member of the House of Representatives from 2012 to 2023. Previously he was a member of the States of Groningen from 2003 to 2007. As a parliamentarian he focused on matters related to finance and housing.
